status_meanings.not_started: No verified work completed for this task at the audited state.
status_meanings.partial: Some source code or preparation exists, but acceptance proof is incomplete.
status_meanings.in_progress: Named owner has started active work on a branch/PR; record link.
status_meanings.blocked: Requires unresolved decision, permission or dependency before implementation can proceed.
status_meanings.verified: All listed acceptance checks passed; each has evidence references; human review confirmed.
status_meanings.not_applicable: Team approved an explicit documented reason this item is inapplicable. Must not be used to skip mandatory rubric items.

update_policy: Recheck repo HEAD and Issue statuses at start; stale baseline is not evidence of current reality.
Change only your assigned task and evidence fields, keeping unrelated status untouched.
Move a task to verified only with commit/PR references and actual test/demo/log evidence.
For blocked task, record blocker and dependency; do not silently assume approval.
Update last_updated_on and append chronological change_log entry with what changed, actor and evidence.
Do not place credentials, secrets, student information, private URLs, or copied access tokens in JSON.
Use separate feature branches/PRs and request a teammate review before merge.
